intended_object: An open map between topological spaces: a function f : X → Y that sends every open subset of X to an open subset of Y. This comes from the docstring and the name.
explanation: The body says exactly that for every open U ⊆ X, the image f '' U is open in Y. That is the textbook definition. Continuity is not assumed, which is also standard. It is stated for arbitrary topological spaces, which is the notion's natural generality. In degenerate cases it agrees with the textbook notion: the empty set always has an open image, and when X is empty every map is open. This is Mathlib's own canonical definition of the concept, so it has no other counterpart.
